title: Lens Replacement Log Status Mix
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lens:replacement
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(replacement_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the lens replacement log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `replacement_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your lens replacement log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
